attchmntText: Jain Resource Recycling Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Investors meet scheduled on November 27, 2026
voiceSummary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited has intimated the schedule for investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. Company officials will attend the Kotak Midcap Conference 2026 in Mumbai on 27th November 2026 at 10:00 AM onwards. The interactions will include one-on-one and group meetings. Discussions will be based solely on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be discussed. The company notes that changes may occur due to exigencies. This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The announcement was issued on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Jain Resource Recycling Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of the earnings call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited filed the transcript of its earnings conference call held on November 4, 2026, regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately INR3,337 crores for the second quarter, an increase of 58% year-on-year. First half revenue reached approximately INR6,061.4 crores. EBITDA for the quarter was approximately INR138 crores with a margin of 4.2%. Profit after tax stood at approximately INR90 crores. The company highlighted the commissioning of its copper anode facility and the commencement of operations at its Ahmedabad subsidiary. Working capital days reduced to 49 days.

attchmntText: Jain Resource Recycling Limited has informed the exchange on monitoring agency report issued by CRISIL Limited
voiceSummary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. The company utilized Rs 54.00 crore from General Corporate Purposes for the part repayment of an unsecured loan from a promoter director during the quarter ended December 31, 2025. This was treated as a deviation. Shareholders approved the ratification of this utilization on April 26, 2026. The company revised the estimated issue expenses from Rs 658.92 million to Rs 263.57 million. Consequently, the amount for general corporate purposes increased from Rs 591.08 million to Rs 986.43 million. The total net proceeds were revised to Rs 4,736.43 million. The Audit Committee reviewed the report on November 3, 2026.
